# uptimekuma_notification_twilio (Resource)

Twilio notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_twilio" "example" {
  name        = "Twilio SMS Notifications"
  account_sid = "ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  auth_token  = "your-auth-token"
  to_number   = "+12025550123"
  from_number = "+12025550456"
  is_active   = true
  is_default  = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_twilio" "with_api_key" {
  name        = "Twilio with API Key"
  account_sid = "ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  api_key     = "your-api-key"
  auth_token  = "your-auth-token"
  to_number   = "+12025550123"
  from_number = "+12025550456"
  is_active   = true
  is_default  = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo and auth_token_wo are
# never stored in plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a
# secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_twilio" "write_only" {
  name        = "Twilio with write-only secrets"
  account_sid = "ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  to_number   = "+12025550123"
  from_number = "+12025550456"

  api_key_wo            = "your-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version    = "1"
  auth_token_wo         = "your-auth-token"
  auth_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_sid` (String, Sensitive) Twilio account SID
- `from_number` (String) Twilio sender phone number
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `to_number` (String) Twilio recipient phone number

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Twilio API key. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Twilio API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Twilio auth token. Stored in state; use `auth_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `auth_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Twilio auth token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `auth_token`; requires `auth_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `auth_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `auth_token` until the next apply with `auth_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `auth_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `auth_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `auth_token_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
